editorial:
Imagine being a top student who has everything figured out, only to have your world flipped upside down by a crush on your teacher. You get to follow a smart high school girl who starts getting private English lessons from her teacher. What starts as a way to get better grades quickly turns into a deep, forbidden romance. The vibe is very soft and emotional, focusing on those nervous feelings you get when you like someone you aren't supposed to. It feels like a classic coming-of-age story where the stakes are high because one wrong move could ruin both of their lives.

The acting feels very natural, and the slow pace helps you feel the tension between the two leads. While some parts might feel a bit too slow for people who want big action, the emotional payoffs are worth it. If you enjoy heartfelt stories about secret love, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see the beautiful scenery, or just rent it on Apple TV for a cozy night in. It is a sweet ride that handles a tricky subject with a lot of care.
endingExplained: In the end, the secret relationship becomes too hard to hide and creates a lot of tension. The teacher realizes that his feelings for the student are wrong and that she needs to grow up on her own. He decides to leave so she can have a normal future. They share a tearful goodbye, knowing they cannot be together right now. It ends on a bittersweet note, showing that true love sometimes means letting go.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves forbidden romance and heartfelt dramas.
